scenes.title: Early Wake-Up
scenes.summary: At five in the morning, Andrea wakes up to soothe her baby daughter Flora, affectionately noting that the little girl already shares her mother's restless nocturnal habits.

scenes.title: The Return of the Past
scenes.summary: Struggling with Colette's sudden departure, Andrea joins José Garcia on his new film set, only for the actor to be completely destabilized by the surprise arrival of his former love Laurence.

scenes.title: José's Shock
scenes.summary: Frozen in disbelief after running into Laurence on set, José Garcia panics over having to work alongside his former flame, while Andrea tries desperately to calm his nerves before filming begins.

scenes.title: José's Hiccups
scenes.summary: On set for a period costume film, actor José Garcia suffers a sudden fit of hiccups that halts production. While trying to drink water upside down, he confides to Andréa the unresolved emotional romance behind his anxiety.

scenes.title: The Tiffany's Shoot
scenes.summary: Before a major Tiffany's photo shoot, Sophia nurses an exhausting hangover and confides to Camille her complicated feelings about Gabriel leaving the party with his new girlfriend.

scenes.title: The Enemy in Our Walls
scenes.summary: Panic spreads through ASK reception as star competitor Élise Formain strides into the building, raising alarm among Camille, Hervé, and Gabriel over a potential hostile takeover.

scenes.title: Élise's Arrival
scenes.summary: In the boardroom, Hicham reveals that rival super-agent Élise Formain is joining ASK with her entire client list, forcing a desperate partners' vote to stave off bankruptcy.

scenes.title: Élise's Arrival
scenes.summary: At ASK, Élise Formain gives a charming speech to win over the team after her arrival from rival Starmédia. While Andréa tries to keep the peace, an indignant Gabriel bitterly refuses to engage and toasts to the death of their agency principles.

scenes.title: The Chef's Stage Fright
scenes.summary: On a chaotic movie set where he plays a high-strung restaurant chef, José Garcia suffers from severe stage fright and repeatedly forgets his lines. Andréa comes to his rescue with a shocking revelation about his former lover and co-star Laurence: she also stood him up at their hotel rendezvous twenty years ago.

scenes.title: Stuck in the Elevator
scenes.summary: Trying to avoid a confrontation with Élise Formain, Gabriel ducks into the ASK elevator, only for Élise to squeeze in with him to demand an explanation. When the elevator suddenly breaks down between floors, a terrified and claustrophobic Gabriel frantically texts for rescue while Élise tries to calm him down.

scenes.title: The César Rival
scenes.summary: At a high-profile photoshoot, Sofia discovers she is scheduled right after Mélanie Meyer, the actress who beat her to the César award. Frustrated by constantly feeling second, Sofia vents to Camille, who encourages her to shine on her own merits.

scenes.title: The End of the Shoot
scenes.summary: After an intense photo session, Sofia finishes her shoot and warmly thanks the studio crew. Camille commends her energy and professionalism, reassuring her that her talent speaks for itself.

scenes.title: José's Unexpected Visit
scenes.summary: Desperate over Colette's disappearance for twenty-four hours, Andréa is suddenly interrupted at home by an exuberant, drunken José Garcia. José boasts about having the wildest night of his life, while Andréa tries desperately to keep him quiet around the sleeping baby.

scenes.title: Morning Panic
scenes.summary: Andréa wakes up late in her apartment to discover that guest José Garcia has disappeared before his morning shoot. When the production driver calls looking for him, Andréa rushes to her baby's bedroom and panics to find Flora's crib empty.

scenes.title: At the Daycare
scenes.summary: Frantic after discovering her empty apartment, Andréa rushes to the daycare center and finds José Garcia happily rocking baby Flora. While Andréa frantically accuses him of child abduction, José playfully urges her to breathe and stay zen before leaving for his set.

scenes.title: The Eco Dinner
scenes.summary: Preparing an elaborate lamb roast to welcome an important film director and his wife, Noémie seeks reassurance from Mathias. Her culinary confidence instantly collapses when Mathias reveals the wife is a militant environmentalist who abhors meat.

scenes.title: An Unexpected Guest
scenes.summary: Mathias and Noémie frantically prepare dinner for producer Igor de Serisy, only for Igor to arrive with his mistress Claire instead of his wife. In the kitchen, Noémie scolds Mathias for the lack of respect, but Mathias reminds her of their own romantic beginnings.

scenes.title: Too Late for a Father
scenes.summary: On the phone with her mother Suzanne, Camille discusses the paternity recognition papers Mathias sent her. Suzanne is furious at Mathias for claiming fatherhood after twenty-seven years of absence, while Camille reassures her mother that she will not change her name.

scenes.title: A Passionate Defense
scenes.summary: At dinner, producer Igor de Serisy criticizes Xavier Beauvois's screenplay for being excessively violent and dark. Noémie boldly interjects to deliver a brilliant literary defense of the script, leaving Igor deeply impressed by her passion and intellect.

scenes.title: My Agent
scenes.summary: In his quiet hotel suite after an exhausting shoot, José Garcia begins to call Andréa his love before quickly correcting himself to 'my agent'. Andréa laughs off the slip of the tongue as room service knocks at the door.

scenes.title: Room Service
scenes.summary: Sitting down at the table in the hotel room, José and Andréa inspect the ordered dishes. Famished from the chaotic day on set, José delights in the food and urges Andréa to take a well-deserved break.

scenes.title: The Profiterole Pact
scenes.summary: Over late-night dessert in the hotel room, Andréa confesses that Colette left her because she always puts her actors before her family. Touched by her sorrow, José proposes a mutual pact to stop acting rashly and reclaim their lives, sealing the promise over a bowl of profiteroles.

scenes.title: A Discreet Escape
scenes.summary: In a luxurious hotel room, José Garcia makes hasty excuses to his companion about an issue with his credit card before quietly slipping away down the corridor.

scenes.title: Expelled from the Creche
scenes.summary: After allowing actor José Garcia to supervise children at the daycare, Andréa is kicked out by the furious director and arrives at ASK with baby Flora in her arms.

scenes.title: An Unexpected Revelation
scenes.summary: Director Valérie Donzelli drops by ASK with a surprise announcement: she wants Hervé to play a lead role in her movie. After she leaves, Camille promises to keep Hervé's new acting secret safe from Gabriel.
